objective: Orientation-first pure M3 forward and return; two fixed M4 configurations; M5 held at deployment 0 command gauge

target.mount: after M5 underside; physical station unknown

detector: Read-only prior observe.py SUBPIX and both positive-depth IPPE branches; minimum reprojection; within 0.25px tie temporal continuity without FK
coverage: Aim four actually visible M3 settings and 20-30deg span per M4 setting, three forward and three reverse steps. Endpoints may be adjusted with measured visibility and conservative clearance.

holdouts.training: Configuration A forward first two M3 increments only
holdouts.prospective: Configuration A third forward increment and ALL A return increments excluded from axis and command-gain fits; entire configuration B excluded from A axis fit
holdouts.conditional_prediction: Use trained axis and heldout observed scalar rotation, label conditional geometry
holdouts.command_only_prediction: Use training-only mean signed increment; heldout observed angle never used

noise: 2-3 stationary F exposures at two visible tilts; 2-3 G board exposures at key F/G/F poses
crosschecks: Sequential F/G/F brackets at start/mid/end key poses; no simultaneous claim; G world rotation = inverse R_G_board; F world per its own valid board

limits.base: No pulses with low or unknown jaw clearance; freeze during pure sweeps

cleanup: stow; app_program_enter_exit flag0; pickup exit; front selected; status and image verify; clear owned consumers without service restarts
adoption: No production edits or commits; rotation cannot identify lengths, axis stations or unique mechanical zeros
safety_retry: Single fresh deployed frame only; if failure inspect first failure and cleanup without preview reopen; any robot error ends trial.
